subject: Onboarding: request for DPIA/Art28-30 evidence and subprocessor details
messages:
From: Julia Meyer <j.meyer@fintechco.com>
To: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Cc: legal@datatrust.com
Date: Sat, 22 May 2027 09:12:00 +0000
Subject: DPIA + Art 28/30 evidence needed for subprocessor onboarding

Hi Karthik,

Thanks for the quick chat earlier. As part of our onboarding checklist at FintechCo, our Data Protection team needs the following to complete the DPIA and contract setup: 

- High-level DPIA or summary showing how personal data flows through Redwood’s systems (preferably a 1-2 page summary).
- Art. 28/30 ledger export (processor/subprocessor mapping by country and data category).
- Current list of subprocessors and their data center regions.
- Any SOC2 / ISO attestation PDFs available, plus evidence of logging/audit retention policy.

We have a short deadline: the internal review board meets next week (30 May). Can you confirm whether you can provide these items and an estimated delivery date? If there are any restrictive redlines in the DPA we should be aware of, flag them now so legal can triage.

If easier, loop in your privacy/security contact — happy to take a short call.

Thanks,
Julia
Julia Meyer
Head of Legal Ops, FintechCo

Planned deliverables and ETA:
- 1-page DPIA summary (scope + data flow diagram): 24 May EOD
- Art.28/30 ledger CSV export with subprocessors and regions: 24 May EOD
- Subprocessor inventory spreadsheet (contact + contract dates): 24 May EOD
- SOC2 Type II and ISO cert links (or PDFs) + log retention summary: 24 May EOD

Clarifications we need from you:
- Which data categories are in scope for the review (PII only, or PII + device/usage telemetry)?
- Do you need customer-specific encryption/KMS details included in the ledger export, or can we provide general key management descriptions?

Action: I’ll send the packet to legal@datatrust.com and you once ready. If we can’t include any low-level KMS configs for security reasons, we’ll include an attestation statement from our security team describing the controls.

Laura & Rishi — looping you for visibility. Laura: can you assemble the ledger export and a short subprocessor inventory? Rishi: can you confirm the logging retention summary and a SOC/ISO pack (or links)?

Thanks — quick clarifications from our side: 

- Data categories in scope: PII (names, emails, account IDs) + transactional metadata (timestamps, IPs).
- KMS detail: we do not need key material; a concise KMS architecture diagram + attestation is sufficient.
- Please include any cross-border transfer mechanisms (SCCs or adequacy reliance) in the ledger rows for non-EEA subprocessors.

We received a preliminary packet attached to this email (three small files). A few notes from legal review: 
- The ledger CSV looks good but please add a column for ‘‘transfer mechanism’’ per row.
- For the DPIA summary, please include a short note on risk mitigations for data residency and vendor access controls.

If you can get the updated files by EOD 24 May we will slot the materials into the review. Happy to take a 30-minute call if any of the internal items need deeper tech input.

— DataTrust Legal (on behalf of FintechCo)
